appDescription.message: Capture, edit, and export complete web pages locally. No account, uploads, or premium lock.

noCaptures.message: Your latest captures will appear here.

libraryCopy.message: Open a capture to edit it, or select several for a batch download or deletion.

emptyLibraryCopy.message: Open any web page and click the PageStitch toolbar icon to create your first full-page screenshot.

batchPdfFallback.message: Batch export uses PNG when PDF is the default.

deleteSelectedConfirm.message: Delete $1 selected captures from local history?

restrictedPage.message: The browser blocks extensions on this page. Open a regular website and try again.

captureInProgress.message: A capture is already running in this tab.

tabNotActive.message: Keep the source tab active until capture finishes.

scrollStuck.message: The page stopped scrolling before its bottom was reached.

captureTruncated.message: This infinite page was capped at 250 sections. The captured portion is complete.

regionHint.message: Drag to select an area · Esc to cancel

dragHint.message: Drag this button to your desktop or file manager.

dragTooLarge.message: This image is too large to drag as one file. Use Export instead.

captureMissing.message: This capture is unavailable or has been deleted.

includeMetadata.message: Include title, URL, and capture date

copyTooLarge.message: This image is too large for the clipboard. Export it instead.

exportParts.message: The page is very long, so it was exported in $1 parts.

outputDefaultsHint.message: Choose how new captures are named and exported.

downloadFolderHint.message: Leave empty to use the default Downloads folder.

saveAsHint.message: Show the Save As dialog for single-file exports.

autoDownloadHint.message: Export with the defaults as soon as capture finishes.

captureHint.message: Give lazy-loaded pages enough time to settle after scrolling.

privacyCopy.message: Screenshots stay in your browser. PageStitch has no analytics, account, remote code, or upload server.

privacySetupIntro.message: PageStitch needs to read the visible pixels, title, and URL of the page you choose to capture.

privacyLocalCopy.message: Screenshots are assembled and edited locally. Nothing is sent to PageStitch or another server.

privacyStoredCopy.message: Captures, page titles, URLs, and annotations stay in local history until you delete them or the history limit removes them.

privacySettingsCopy.message: Non-sensitive preferences may sync through your browser account when browser sync is available.

privacyAssurance.message: No analytics, ads, account, data sale, remote code, or background page monitoring.

privacyEnabled.message: PageStitch is enabled. Close this tab and capture the page again.

shortcutsHint.message: Alt + Shift + P — full page · Alt + Shift + V — visible area

deleteConfirm.message: Delete this capture from local history?
